exposure: Prenatal Care Coordination (PNCC) participation during pregnancy (none, assessment/care plan only, or service receipt)
outcome: Any postpartum visit (within 30 days after birth)
Any postpartum visit (within 90 days after birth)
Emergency department (ED) admission within 30 days after birth
Kotelchuck Index of prenatal care adequacy
cohort: The study participants were Medicaid beneficiaries in Wisconsin who experienced live births between 2011 and 2019.
finding: PNCC service receipt was positively associated with 30-day postpartum visits and ED admissions, and negatively associated with severe maternal morbidity and adequate prenatal care in bias-limiting sibling fixed effects models.
